notable_patterns: Extensive use of wait_for_object pattern with configurable timeout and raise_e parameters
Consistent error handling with popup dismissal (feature_unavailable_text, fw_update dialogs)
Environment-specific logic (stage_prod vs regular device cards)
Retry mechanisms with change_check validation for critical actions
JavaScript executor fallback for problematic clicks (account_panel_close_button)
Screenshot comparison decorator for visual validation
Format specifier pattern for dynamic element identification
Compound verification methods checking multiple element states
Sleep delays for UI stabilization after certain actions
Attribute extraction pattern using get_attribute with 'Name' attribute
Invisible/displayed flags for checking element visibility states
Index-based element selection from multiple matching elements
Conditional navigation with fallback refresh logic
